topics.label: Course and Lecture Introduction
topics.groupedBecause: The lecturer introduces the final lecture of the course and outlines its learning objectives regarding cancer therapy.

topics.label: Conventional Cancer Therapies and Cytotoxic Chemotherapy
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain the principles, mechanisms, successes, and adverse limitations of standard cancer treatments, including surgery, radiotherapy, and cytotoxic chemotherapeutic agents.

topics.label: Targeting Tumor Vulnerabilities, Checkpoint Defects, and DNA Repair Deficiencies
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explore therapeutic strategies that exploit intrinsic cancer cell defects, including hormone receptor dependency, cell cycle checkpoint loss, and synthetic lethality in DNA repair pathways.

topics.label: Oncogene Addiction and Kinase Inhibitors
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics discuss the identification of driver oncogenes, the design of small-molecule kinase inhibitors, and the biological mechanisms of resistance and addiction that develop against them.

topics.label: Monoclonal Antibodies and Antibody-Drug Conjugates
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics detail therapeutic approaches that use engineered monoclonal antibodies and antibody-drug conjugates to target cancer cell surface antigens.

topics.label: Immune Surveillance and Immune Checkpoint Inhibition
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics address the body's natural antitumor immunity and the mechanism of reactivating exhausted T cells using immune checkpoint inhibitors targeting tumor neoantigens.

topics.label: Engineered T-Cell Therapies and Bispecific Engagers
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine advanced immunotherapies that physically engage or genetically reprogram immune cells against tumor antigens, including BiTEs and CAR T cells.

topics.label: Challenges, Progress, and Future Directions in Cancer Therapy
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics review the systemic challenges, historical progress, future opportunities, and clinical dilemmas in treating cancer and improving patient outcomes.
